name: firedrill
description: Run and inspect real agent simulations, or author private synthetic dependencies, using Firedrill.

interface.longDescription: Prepare agent simulations, manage synthetic dependencies and inspect retained evidence through Firedrill's authenticated remote MCP. Running the customer's actual application requires a separately authorized customer-owned CLI or SDK runner. These skills contain instructions, not an execution runtime or account credentials; remote admission never launches code on the customer's machine.
defaultPrompt: Use Firedrill to simulate this application across useful scenarios and show the retained evidence.
